title: Robbery Planner
description: A row of locations contains non-negative values. Select locations for maximum total value, but adjacent locations cannot both be selected.
inputFormat: First line: n. Second line: n values.
outputFormat: Print the maximum achievable total value.
hints: For each location, compare skipping it with taking it together with the best result two positions earlier.

examples.explanation: Selecting 2, 9 and 1 gives a total of 12.
The first and last locations can both be selected.
